findings.title: Pin the verified backend when materializing income inputs
findings.trigger: Build both source country caches for 2011-12 through the default public API, then request all-wave income under LSMS_BUILD_BACKEND=make with income absent.
findings.cause: The inherited make backend bypasses coverage validation and mtime-skips the new prerequisite-free wrapper targets; get_dataframe then consumes valid but partial raw siblings.
findings.requested_fix: Pin LSMS_BUILD_BACKEND=dvc during public sibling materialization in income.py and restore its prior environment state in finally; retain the raw arithmetic.

limits: No broad suite or corpus rebuild
No FDC calls, raw acquisition, shared-cache edits or promotion
General arbitrary-stale Make bypass not investigated
Ethiopia source census remains diagnosis only; no Ethiopia live-build assertion
Amended mutable Uganda implementation outside this frozen review
